# Scene Time

Outputs the sequencer playhead time.

`lfs.scene_time` · Input

## How to use

Use Seconds or Frame to animate fields.\
Only time-dependent graphs re-evaluate during playback.\
Video export waits for each frame’s evaluated geometry.

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Seconds | `Seconds` | lfs.float | — | — | Playhead time in seconds. |
| Frame | `Frame` | lfs.float | — | — | Playhead time multiplied by the sequencer frame rate. |
